gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the soundcore Space 2 Pro costs $199.99 on soundcore's US store (read 2026-11-14) and has a 6-mic call array. Sony's WH-1000XM6 also has 6 call mics and costs $379.99 at Target. Jabra's Evolve3 85 has 6 MEMS mics and no boom, with a US price of $649. In SoundGuys' review of the Space 2 Pro, Adam Birney 'could barely hear any background noise at all' in its office and street mic recordings.
standout_why: I compared against the cited SoundGuys work page (2026-10-22). Its picks are Sony XM6 ($449.99), Jabra Evolve3 85 ($649), AirPods Max 2 ($549), Sennheiser Momentum 5 ($399.95) and Alienware Pro ($229.99, its 'best value'). It has no soundcore model and gives no mic numbers. ChatGPT's answers named the Space Q45 only as the budget pick, and that model is out of stock on soundcore's store today. The cited RTINGS calls and office pages returned no article text to WebFetch, so I could not check their picks. None of the results ChatGPT got includes SoundGuys' Space 2 Pro review from 2026-11-09.
decides: This changes the budget and value pick. For about half the price of the Sony XM6, the Space 2 Pro has the same 6-mic call count and a named reviewer's verdict that it rejects background noise. It costs $30 less than SoundGuys' $229.99 value pick, and the Q45 that ChatGPT recommended is out of stock. Sony XM6 at $379.99 stays best overall. For calls, the $649 Evolve3 85 has no boom arm (per Jabra's spec page), so a buyer who wants a boom has to go to the Evolve2 85 (10 mics, $649 at AVI-SPL) or the Evolve2 65 Flex.
